verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Raygun's providers are open source, which let a user write their own NancyFX-specific provider. That suggests the ingestion path is open enough to extend or replicate, but nothing in the pack documents the ingestion endpoint or payload format itself. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the event-ingestion API/payload schema, a published spec for building custom clients, evidence of third-party compatible SDKs, hands-on corroboration of sending events without an official SDK.
